label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
**To whoever is using the bin at No. 14,**

Someone on this terrace has been putting full bags of rubbish into my grey bin, and I’ve had enough of it.

The bin is with Greenmount Bins and I’m charged 41 cent for every kilo. My last bill was €63.20 for two months. It’s normally around €25. I’m not paying for someone else’s rubbish on top of my own, especially when it’s been happening every week for about a month.

I live in the rented house at No. 14. The number is painted in white on the lid, so there’s no confusion about which bin it is. It goes out on Tuesday night and is collected on Wednesday morning.

Last Tuesday I got home at 3am after a gig to find the lid wouldn’t even close. There were three black bags in it that weren’t mine, including one with nappies. That’s not someone slipping in a few bits because they were stuck. That’s someone using my bin as their own and leaving me with the bill.

I found an envelope from a gas bill in one of the bags. The name had been torn off, but it had the terrace on it. A neighbour also saw a car pull up on Tuesday evening, though he didn’t see who it was. I don’t know who’s doing it, which is why I’m putting this through every door rather than pointing the finger at anyone.

I work nights, so I’m not always here when the bin goes out. That doesn’t mean I’m a pushover or that the bin is there for anyone to fill.

If you’re stuck and don’t know how to arrange a bin collection, knock in and ask me. I’ll tell you who to ring. It’s not hard.

Otherwise, stop putting your rubbish in my bin. Simple as that. If it keeps happening, I’ll start locking it with a padlock.

Thanks,  
No. 14, Aughrim Terrace
